newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Congress okays state revenue sharing law.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Congress okays state revenue sharing law.

text.p: Venezuela's Congress passed Wednesday a law that will allow states to directly receive a portion of the oil revenues they produce.
Approval of the Assignations Law brings to an end the possibility of a civil strike in Venezuela's most important oil producing state, Zulia, originally slated for Nov 29.

Under the law, states will directly receive 10 percent of the oil, iron, bauxite, gold and coal revenues they produce. That 10 percent will then be split 70 percent for producing states and 30 percent for non-producers. The funds will come on top of the states' constitutionally-mandated budget allocations.
The government has long opposed the law, arguing it would increase regional inequalities.
